children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
Is the Innokin Plexus Go the same as the Innokin Plexus Pro?
No.
The Innokin Plexus Go is the smaller, simpler kit: 1000mAh battery, LED indicator, fixed power matched to the pod and side airflow.
The Innokin Plexus Pro has a 1350mAh battery, a colour screen, adjustable 6W to 25W output and rear airflow. Both use the same Innokin Plexus cartridges, so pods for one fit the other.
Which pods fit the Innokin Plexus Go?
The Innokin Plexus Go takes
Innokin Plexus cartridges in 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω and 1.2Ω

, the same 2ml cartridges used by the Innokin Plexus Pro. It does not take Innokin Klypse, EQ, EQs or Endura V pods, and Innokin Zenith Plexus-Z or Scion Plexus coils are tank coils, not pods, despite the shared name.
How long do Innokin vapes last?
The Innokin Plexus Go battery lasts a full day for most MTL vapers because its
1000mAh cell only runs at 12W to 16W
; light users report it stretching into a second day. Each 2ml fill lasts roughly a day, and a 0.8Ω Innokin Plexus cartridge typically lasts one to two weeks before flavour fades.
Is Innokin a good vape brand?
Innokin is one of the longest-running vape hardware makers, known for MTL kits such as the Innokin Endura T18 series and the Zenith tanks.
The Innokin Plexus Go carries that MTL focus into a low-cost pod kit
with a stainless steel frame, a transparent cartridge and pod-matched power that protects the coil.
Does the Innokin Plexus Go come with a charging cable?
Most UK listings state that
no USB-C cable is included

with the Innokin Plexus Go; the box holds the device, one 0.8Ω cartridge and a manual. Any standard USB-C lead from a phone will charge it. Use a normal USB port rather than a car charger, which Innokin's manual advises against.
Why is my Innokin Plexus Go flashing red?
Eight red flashes on the Innokin Plexus Go mean the
battery is nearly flat and output has been cut
; plug in a USB-C cable and it will fire again once charged. If it flashes with a full battery, remove the cartridge, wipe e-liquid off the contacts and refit it until it clicks.
What e-liquid should I use in the Innokin Plexus Go?
Use
50/50 PG/VG e-liquid in 10ml bottles

, ideally nic salts: 20mg for heavy smokers, 10mg for lighter smokers, 5mg when cutting down. Freebase 50/50 at 6mg to 12mg also works in the 0.6Ω and 0.8Ω cartridges. Avoid thick 70/30 shortfills, which wick slowly and burn the mesh.
How do I fill the Innokin Plexus Go pod?
Fill the Innokin Plexus Go from the top in five steps:
Slide the top cap of the cartridge open to reveal the fill port.
Drip 50/50 e-liquid in until just below the top; do not overfill.
Slide the cap shut and let the cartridge stand upright for 10 minutes on a first fill.
Push the cartridge into the battery until it clicks.
Inhale slowly to fire; top up when the level drops to a quarter.
